_doc: One record per labelled listing, one JSON object per line in a .jsonl file. Blank (null) means the listing doesn't say, or says two different things. The labelling tool writes this format; evals/harness/labels.py checks it. See docs/labelling-guide.md.
_doc_prefilled: Fields the tool showed pre-filled from the page's table and ticks, and which of those the labeller changed.
